sources.entry: HistCite Mac - Open-source bibliometric analysis and citation network visualization for Web of Science exports. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/yangnim21029/histcite-mac) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: HistCite Mac is an independent, free and open-source macOS app for organizing Web of Science records, analyzing citation relationships locally, and visualizing them with Graph Maker.
keywords: find most cited papers in my collection
visualize how papers cite each other
use_cases: Find the most-cited papers within a Web of Science search result
Map how papers in a collection cite each other over time
Analyze authors, journals, years and countries in a literature set
Clean and merge duplicate bibliographic records
Export citation data to a spreadsheet or network-analysis tool
Run HistCite-style analysis on a Mac without Windows
how_to_run: Download the Universal DMG from the latest release on the project's release page
Open the DMG and drag HistCite Mac into Applications
On first launch, if blocked, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway
Export Web of Science records as Plain Text with Full Record and Cited References
In the app, choose File → Open collection… and select the .txt files
Use Tools → Graph Maker… to draw the citation map
notable: Runs entirely locally; no upload of the collection to a server
Reads Web of Science tagged plain-text exports directly, plus .hci and .hcm files
Graph Maker exports SVG, PNG, PostScript, DOT and Pajek formats
Follows HistCite 12.03.17 workflows as an independent implementation, not the original program
Includes a 12-record fictional demo collection in the DMG
caveats: The community release is not Apple-notarized, so macOS may require a manual approval step on first launch
Native Scopus exports and Excel files must be converted to WoS tagged format first; compatibility is only validated within tested datasets
summary.license: MIT (original code); bundled components keep their own licenses (Graphviz CPL 1.0, sorting adapter BSD-3-Clause)
